newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman offers new three-year development bonds.
newsitem.headline: Oman offers new three-year development bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank of Oman said on Tuesday subscription to the sixteenth issue of government development bonds would open from May 17 to May 28.
It said the three-year bonds carried a coupon of 7.75 percent. Interest would be paid twice a year, the Bank said in a statement.
The bonds, issued in multiples of 100 rials, would "be open for subscription to the domestic investors irrespective of their nationality", the Central Bank said.
It did not give the total value of bonds on offer.
